generated_assets.title: Diferencias entre aprendizaje supervisado y no supervisado
generated_assets.body: El aprendizaje supervisado utiliza datos etiquetados para entrenar modelos, mientras que el no supervisado busca patrones en datos sin etiquetas. Sigue estos pasos: 1. Identifica si tu conjunto de datos tiene etiquetas de salida conocidas. 2. Si las tiene, aplica algoritmos de aprendizaje supervisado. 3. Si no las tiene, utiliza técnicas de aprendizaje no supervisado para hallar estructuras. 4. Considera el aprendizaje semi-supervisado si tienes una mezcla de ambos tipos de datos. Ejemplo: Clasificar correos como spam (etiquetado) vs. agrupar clientes por comportamiento (no etiquetado).

evidence.snippet:
Pregunta: What is the difference between supervised and unsupervised learning?
Respuesta: In supervised learning, the model is trained on labeled data, where the output is known, while in unsupervised learning, the model is trained on unlabeled data, and it tries to find patterns or structures in the data.

Pregunta: What is semi-supervised learning?
Respuesta: Semi-supervised learning is a machine learning paradigm that combines labeled and unlabeled data to improve model performance, often by leveraging the inherent structure or relationships in the data to semi-supervised learning algorithms.

Pregunta: What is the difference between classification and regression?
Respuesta: Classification is a task where the goal is to predict the category or class label of an input, while regression is a task where the goal is to predict a continuous numerical value.

Pregunta: What is regularization in linear regression?
Respuesta: Regularization in linear regression involves adding a penalty term to the ordinary least squares (OLS) loss function to prevent overfitting, with common regularization techniques including Ridge regression (L2 regularization) and Lasso regression (L1 regularization).
